build_VitNormalHead2: build a VitNormalHead2 decode head with deconv, upsample conv, and conv layers for monocular depth estimation
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation from channel and kernel size sequences
create_make_upsample_conv_layers: create upsample conv layers with bicubic 2x upsampling followed by convolution, normalization, and activation
create_make_deconv_layers: create transposed convolution deconvolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU for feature map upsampling
run_loss_by_feat: run loss computation by resizing logits, masking valid depth regions, and applying configured decode losses
